answer: Because the timing is published against the trellis challenge, the haven audit can replay the oasis history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 62 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1481 identities would post 3573 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
